meta.name: nanoresearch-ideation
meta.description: Search academic literature and generate research hypotheses

copy.tagline: 搜索学术文献并生成研究假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从学术文献中提炼新的研究方向
copy.tagline_en: Search academic literature and generate research hypotheses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to derive new research directions from academic papers

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能搜索 arXiv 和 Semantic Scholar 上的学术论文，分析研究空白，并生成 2-4 个新颖的研究假设，最后选出一个最 promising 的假设并说明理由。
howto.when: 当你提出一个研究主题或问题，需要查找相关文献并生成新假设时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于量子点太阳能电池的最新论文，并生成研究假设。
say.note: Claude 会搜索文献并产出假设。

say.text: 分析石墨烯在电池中的应用，找出研究空白。
say.note: Claude 会进行差距分析并生成假设。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search arXiv and Semantic Scholar for academic papers, perform gap analysis, and generate 2-4 novel research hypotheses, then select the most promising one with justification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a research topic or question and need to find related literature and generate new hypotheses.

say_en.text: Search for latest papers on quantum dot solar cells and generate research hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will search and output hypotheses.

say_en.text: Analyze research gaps in graphene applications for batteries.
say_en.note: Claude will perform gap analysis and generate hypotheses.
